text:
If you've got an evening walk in you, tonight's the one to take — clear skies, light north winds easing to nearly nothing, and that mid-70s warmth sliding down toward a comfortable low around 57. The lake's basically glassy, waves a foot or less, water still holding at 73, so it's a fine night to be near the water even after the sun's down.

Tomorrow keeps the good mood going: mostly sunny, high near 80, air quality good. The American model wants to push closer to 83 while the Euro holds near 78, so I'd call it upper 70s to around 80 and not sweat the difference. Winds stay light through the morning on the lake before turning south, and it's still calm enough for paddling or a swim. Enjoy it while it's simple, because that next system starts nosing in Saturday night, and Sunday brings showers back into the forecast. Good outdoor window through Saturday afternoon; I'd have Sunday's plans indoors as a backup.
